name: Small Weapons
description: Small weapons are those which are easily wielded in one hand, including everyday tools improvised as weapons. They require no especial skill to use, are easily concealed, and are typically wielded by civilians. These weapons automatically have the light property, and can be dual-wielded or used in the offhand.

weapons.name: Cleaver
weapons.description: A heavy knife for cutting meat.

weapons.name: Club
weapons.description: Any hefty stick or chair leg will do.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.description: A short sidearm, suitable for slashing or stabbing. The “Sharp” property does not apply when thrown.

weapons.name: Hatchet
weapons.description: A small axe suitable for throwing

weapons.name: Knife
weapons.description: An ordinary workman’s knife

weapons.name: Sickle
weapons.description: A farmer’s tool of dubious sharpness. May be modified by a blacksmith to lose the Improvised trait, for 50 gold.

weapons.name: Stiletto
weapons.description: A stabbing knife, long and sharp. Ignores BC from chainmail.

weapons.name: Tanto
weapons.description: A short slashing blade with an angular tip.

name: Standard Weapons
description: These are proper weapon and sidearms, usable in one hand. Some of these require martial training, or accommodate a two-handed grip.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword
weapons.description: A flexible sword with many uses.

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.description: An axe especially designed for combat

weapons.name: Bearded Axe
weapons.description: An axe with its weight balanced at the head.

weapons.name: Broadsword
weapons.description: A sword for slashing, of a category including the cutlass, machete, falchion, and scimitar.

weapons.name: Estoc
weapons.description: A soldier’s thrusting sword for piercing mail. In the right hands, can be used to ignore chainmail BC.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.description: A martial weapon for crushing armor.

weapons.name: Morningstar
weapons.description: A martial weapon, spiked for piercing mail. Damage becomes bludgeoning versus plate armor.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.description: A rapscallion’s sword—or a gentleman’s...

weapons.name: Shortsword
weapons.description: A shorter sword of lighter weight, making an ideal sidearm. Similar to the arming sword and gladius.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.description: More than a walking staff, in skilled hands. Improvised trait does not apply when attacking with dexterity.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.description: A pointed weapon for throwing or stabbing. Range: 20/60

weapons.name: Wakizashi
weapons.description: A curved sword of foreign make. Excellent craftsmanship.

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.description: A large hammer, sized for one or two hands.

name: Great Weapons
description: Great Weapons are two-handed martial weapons that sacrifice precision for power. This category includes polearms, which are the primary weapons of infantry and possess excellent damage and reach.

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.description: A knight’s two-handed sword. May be upgraded by a blacksmith to gain Sharp for 150 gold.

weapons.name: Katana
weapons.description: Lighter and sharper than a longsword.

weapons.name: Claymore
weapons.description: An exceptionally powerful two-handed sword

weapons.name: Greataxe
weapons.description: A large axe well suited to those possessing great brawn

weapons.name: Maul
weapons.description: A greathammer, for smashing through armor.

weapons.name: Bardiche
weapons.description: 'Tis a poleaxe, nothing less.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.description: A poleaxe and spear combination that can pierce, slash, or bludgeon.

weapons.name: Pike
weapons.description: A thrusting polearm too heavy for throwing. Similar to the glaive, partisan, billhook, and fauchard.

weapons.name: Naginata
weapons.description: A light polearm favored by the deft.

weapons.name: Lance
weapons.description: An extremely long spear, designed for mounted combat. Improvised trait does not apply if attacking from horseback.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.description: A triple pointed polearm.

name: Ranged Weapons
description: Weapons designed to be thrown or to launch a projectile.

weapons.name: Throwing Knives
weapons.description: Knives specially designed to be hurled.

weapons.name: Shuriken
weapons.description: A thrown, spinning weapon from a distant land.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.description: A light spear, made for throwing.

weapons.name: Boomerang
weapons.description: A throwing weapon that returns to its user. May be enchanted to return items to the thrower, for 200 gold. Range: 30/90

weapons.name: Shortbow
weapons.description: A bow favored by hunters and spies.

weapons.name: Longbow
weapons.description: The bow used by professional archers.

weapons.name: Hand Crossbow
weapons.description: A miniature crossbow. Widely considered a gimmick.

weapons.name: Crossbow
weapons.description: A mechanical bow operated by a trigger.

weapons.name: Arbalest
weapons.description: A crossbow of monstrous proportions.

weapons.name: Pistol
weapons.description: A compact firearm, carried in one hand. Designed to be fired once and then holstered.

weapons.name: Hand Cannon
weapons.description: A heavy pistol, for those strong enough to wield it. Light modifier does not apply if strength is less than 16.

weapons.name: Arquebus
weapons.description: A powerful and unpredictable firearm.

weapons.name: Blunderbus
weapons.description: A heavier gun, firing grapeshot.

weapons.name: Musket
weapons.description: The pinnacle of technological prowess.

name: Special Weapons
description: Weapons with atypical abilities for specialized use.

weapons.name: Net
weapons.description: For catching and restraining.

weapons.name: Grappling Hook
weapons.description: For hooking and pulling, or escaping. Allows Vertical Escape and Come Hither.

weapons.name: Flail
weapons.description: For countering shields.

weapons.name: Hook Sword
weapons.description: For disarming opponents.

weapons.name: Buckler
weapons.description: A small shield. Allows shield bash.

weapons.name: Shield
weapons.description: An ordinary shield. Allows shield bash.

weapons.name: Greatshield
weapons.description: An extraordinarily large shield. Allows shield charge.

weapons.name: Mantlet
weapons.description: A shield designed to be carried with two hands or planted on the ground. Cannot perform weapon attacks while carrying this shield. Provides cover when placed on the ground. Allows shield charge.
